blocks.en_text: In the biblical story of the Tower of Babel,
blocks.zh_text: 在《圣经》中巴别塔的故事里，

blocks.en_text: all of humanity once spoke a single language
blocks.zh_text: 全人类曾经只说一种语言，

blocks.en_text: until they suddenly split into many groups
blocks.zh_text: 直到他们突然分裂成许多群体，

blocks.en_text: unable to understand each other.
blocks.zh_text: 彼此无法理解。

blocks.en_text: We don't really know if such an original language ever existed,
blocks.zh_text: 我们并不真的知道这样一种原始语言是否曾经存在过，

blocks.en_text: but we do know that the thousands of languages existing today
blocks.zh_text: 但我们确实知道，今天存在的数千种语言

blocks.en_text: can be traced back to a much smaller number.
blocks.zh_text: 都可以追溯到数量少得多的一些语言。

blocks.en_text: So how did we end up with so many?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，我们怎么会有这么多语言呢？

blocks.en_text: In the early days of human migration,
blocks.zh_text: 在人类迁徙的早期，

blocks.en_text: the world was much less populated.
blocks.zh_text: 世界人口要少得多。

blocks.en_text: Groups of people that shared a single language and culture
blocks.zh_text: 共享同一种语言和文化的群体

blocks.en_text: often split into smaller tribes,
blocks.zh_text: 常常分裂成更小的部落，

blocks.en_text: going separate ways in search of fresh game and fertile land.
blocks.zh_text: 为了寻找新的猎物和肥沃的土地而各奔东西。

blocks.en_text: As they migrated and settled in new places,
blocks.zh_text: 随着他们迁徙并在新的地方定居，

blocks.en_text: they became isolated from one another
blocks.zh_text: 他们彼此隔绝开来，

blocks.en_text: and developed in different ways.
blocks.zh_text: 并以不同的方式发展。

blocks.en_text: Centuries of living in different conditions,
blocks.zh_text: 几个世纪生活在不同的环境中，

blocks.en_text: eating different food
blocks.zh_text: 吃不同的食物，

blocks.en_text: and encountering different neighbors
blocks.zh_text: 接触不同的邻居，

blocks.en_text: turned similar dialects with varied pronunciation and vocabulary
blocks.zh_text: 使发音和词汇各异的相似方言

blocks.en_text: into radically different languages,
blocks.zh_text: 变成了截然不同的语言，

blocks.en_text: continuing to divide as populations grew and spread out further.
blocks.zh_text: 并随着人口增长和进一步扩散而继续分化。

blocks.en_text: Like genealogists, modern linguists try to map this process
blocks.zh_text: 像家谱学家一样，现代语言学家试图描绘这一过程，

blocks.en_text: by tracing multiple languages back as far as they can
blocks.zh_text: 尽可能地把多种语言往前追溯，

blocks.en_text: to their common ancestor, or protolanguage.
blocks.zh_text: 追溯到它们的共同祖先，也就是原始语言。

blocks.en_text: A group of all languages related in this way is called a language family,
blocks.zh_text: 以这种方式相关联的所有语言构成一个语系，

blocks.en_text: which can contain many branches and sub-families.
blocks.zh_text: 其中可以包含许多分支和子语系。

blocks.en_text: So how do we determine whether languages are related in the first place?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，我们首先如何判断语言之间是否相关呢？

blocks.en_text: Similar sounding words don't tell us much.
blocks.zh_text: 发音相似的词并不能告诉我们太多。

blocks.en_text: They could be false cognates or just directly borrowed terms
blocks.zh_text: 它们可能是假同源词，或者只是直接借用的词，

blocks.en_text: rather than derived from a common root.
blocks.zh_text: 而不是源自共同的词根。

blocks.en_text: Grammar and syntax are a more reliable guide,
blocks.zh_text: 语法和句法是更可靠的指南，

blocks.en_text: as well as basic vocabulary,
blocks.zh_text: 基本词汇也是如此，

blocks.en_text: such as pronouns, numbers or kinship terms,
blocks.zh_text: 比如代词、数字或亲属称谓，

blocks.en_text: that's less likely to be borrowed.
blocks.zh_text: 这些不太可能被借用。

blocks.en_text: By systematically comparing these features
blocks.zh_text: 通过系统地比较这些特征，

blocks.en_text: and looking for regular patterns of sound changes
blocks.zh_text: 并寻找音变的规律模式

blocks.en_text: and correspondences between languages,
blocks.zh_text: 以及语言之间的对应关系，

blocks.en_text: linguists can determine relationships,
blocks.zh_text: 语言学家可以确定语言之间的关系，

blocks.en_text: trace specific steps in their evolution
blocks.zh_text: 追溯它们演变中的具体步骤，

blocks.en_text: and even reconstruct earlier languages with no written records.
blocks.zh_text: 甚至重建没有文字记录的早期语言。

blocks.en_text: Linguistics can even reveal other important historical clues,
blocks.zh_text: 语言学甚至能揭示其他重要的历史线索，

blocks.en_text: such as determining the geographic origins and lifestyles of ancient peoples
blocks.zh_text: 比如确定古代民族的地理起源和生活方式，

blocks.en_text: based on which of their words were native,
blocks.zh_text: 依据是他们的哪些词是本族词，

blocks.en_text: and which were borrowed.
blocks.zh_text: 哪些是借来的。

blocks.en_text: There are two main problems linguists face
blocks.zh_text: 语言学家在构建这些语系树时

blocks.en_text: when constructing these language family trees.
blocks.zh_text: 面临两个主要问题。

blocks.en_text: One is that there is no clear way of deciding
blocks.zh_text: 一是没有明确的方法来决定

blocks.en_text: where the branches at the bottom should end, that is,
blocks.zh_text: 最底层的分支应该在哪里结束，也就是说，

blocks.en_text: which dialects should be considered separate languages or vice versa.
blocks.zh_text: 哪些方言应该算作独立的语言，或者反过来。

blocks.en_text: Chinese is classified as a single language,
blocks.zh_text: 汉语被归类为一种单一语言，

blocks.en_text: but its dialects vary to the point of being mutually unintelligible,
blocks.zh_text: 但它的各方言差异之大，已经到了彼此无法听懂的程度，

blocks.en_text: while speakers of Spanish and Portuguese
blocks.zh_text: 而说西班牙语和葡萄牙语的人

blocks.en_text: can often understand each other.
blocks.zh_text: 却常常能听懂对方。

blocks.en_text: Languages actually spoken by living people
blocks.zh_text: 活人实际说的语言

blocks.en_text: do not exist in neatly divided categories,
blocks.zh_text: 并不存在于划分得整整齐齐的类别里，

blocks.en_text: but tend to transition gradually,
blocks.zh_text: 而往往是逐渐过渡的，

blocks.en_text: crossing borders and classifications.
blocks.zh_text: 跨越国界和分类。

blocks.en_text: Often the difference between languages and dialects
blocks.zh_text: 语言和方言之间的区别，往往

blocks.en_text: is a matter of changing political and national considerations,
blocks.zh_text: 取决于不断变化的政治和民族考量，

blocks.en_text: rather than any linguistic features.
blocks.zh_text: 而不是任何语言特征。

blocks.en_text: This is why the answer to, "How many languages are there?"
blocks.zh_text: 这就是为什么“世界上有多少种语言？”的答案

blocks.en_text: can be anywhere between 3,000 and 8,000,
blocks.zh_text: 可以是3000到8000之间的任何数字，

blocks.en_text: depending on who's counting.
blocks.zh_text: 取决于谁来数。

blocks.en_text: The other problem is that the farther we move back in time
blocks.zh_text: 另一个问题是，我们越往时间深处回溯，

blocks.en_text: towards the top of the tree,
blocks.zh_text: 越靠近这棵树的顶端，

blocks.en_text: the less evidence we have about the languages there.
blocks.zh_text: 关于那里语言的证据就越少。

blocks.en_text: The current division of major language families
blocks.zh_text: 目前对主要语系的划分

blocks.en_text: represents the limit at which relationships can be established
blocks.zh_text: 代表了能够确立亲缘关系的极限，

blocks.en_text: with reasonable certainty,
blocks.zh_text: 而且是有相当把握的，

blocks.en_text: meaning that languages of different families
blocks.zh_text: 也就是说，不同语系的语言

blocks.en_text: are presumed not to be related on any level.
blocks.zh_text: 被认为在任何层面上都没有关联。

blocks.en_text: But this may change.
blocks.zh_text: 但这可能会改变。

blocks.en_text: While many proposals for higher level relationships --
blocks.zh_text: 虽然许多关于更高层级关系的提议——

blocks.en_text: or super families -- are speculative,
blocks.zh_text: 也就是超级语系——都只是推测，

blocks.en_text: some have been widely accepted
blocks.zh_text: 有些已被广泛接受，

blocks.en_text: and others are being considered,
blocks.zh_text: 还有些正在被考虑，

blocks.en_text: especially for native languages with small speaker populations
blocks.zh_text: 尤其是那些使用者人数很少的土著语言，

blocks.en_text: that have not been extensively studied.
blocks.zh_text: 它们还没有被充分研究过。

blocks.en_text: We may never be able to determine how language came about,
blocks.zh_text: 我们也许永远无法确定语言是如何产生的，

blocks.en_text: or whether all human languages did in fact have a common ancestor
blocks.zh_text: 也无法确定是否所有人类语言确实都有一个共同的祖先，

blocks.en_text: scattered through the babel of migration.
blocks.zh_text: 散落在迁徙的纷乱之中。

blocks.en_text: But the next time you hear a foreign language, pay attention.
blocks.zh_text: 但下次你听到一门外语时，留心听一听。

blocks.en_text: It may not be as foreign as you think.
blocks.zh_text: 它可能没有你想的那么陌生。
